objectives: Measure decoding and encoding of taught /l/ CVC words.
Check emerging fluency and determine the next learning route.
concepts: A diagnostic samples multiple skills rather than one isolated task.
Mastery requires accuracy across critical phonics components.
Fluency includes accuracy, smoothness, and meaning.
Diagnostic results should route learners to targeted remediation when needed.

definitions.definition: An assessment used to identify strengths, gaps, and next instructional needs.
Reading accurately, smoothly, and with appropriate phrasing while maintaining meaning.
Performance meeting the defined threshold across required skills.

workedExamples: Sound recognition: identify /l/ in a spoken or printed word.
Decoding: map l to /l/, blend with the vowel and final consonant.
Encoding: segment a CVC word and write each grapheme.
Comprehension: answer using information explicitly stated in the controlled text.
commonMistakes: Reading accurately but not understanding the passage.
Reading quickly while making frequent decoding errors.
keyTakeaways: Route weak skills to targeted remediation.

basic: Review taught /l/ sound, decoding, and spelling items.
conceptual: Explain which phonics component an error belongs to.
application: Select an appropriate remediation response from diagnostic evidence.
higherOrderThinking: Interpret a mixed-skill result and determine whether the learner is ready to advance.
mixedReview: Revisit /l/ skills across recognition, decoding, encoding, comprehension, and fluency.

quickRevision: recognise → decode → spell → comprehend → read fluently
formulaOrFactBank: Mastery target = 0.80 overall with no critical component below target.
mistakeBasedRevision: Identify the weak component first, then reteach and reassess that skill.
weakTopicRevision: Use the diagnostic component score to select targeted /l/ remediation.

activities.name: Error classification
steps: Classify it as recognition, decoding, encoding, comprehension, or fluency.

outcomes: Learner demonstrates measurable /l/ consolidation across critical phonics components.
Teacher/system can identify weak components for targeted remediation.
Learner advances only when the defined mastery threshold is met.

routing.advance: Advance when overall score is at least 0.80 and no critical component is below target.
routing.remediate: Route to targeted remediation for any critical component below target.

questions.question: Which result best supports moving forward from this diagnostic?
options: At least 80% overall with no critical component below target.
Fast reading with many decoding errors.
